summary: Remote agent with WebSocket-driven PTY and self-updating obfuscated runtime
details: @whalent/agent-core ships a 13MB obfuscated main bundle (dist/index.cjs) that combines a WebSocket client with PTY primitives (PtyProcess/IPty/xterm, optional node-pty), child_process.spawn, and ssh2 — the shape of a network-driven shell agent where a remote party can drive terminal input/output on the installer's host. The README states the package is 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades', and the bundle contains update/upgrade/semver code paths alongside the WebSocket client, so a remote daemon controlled by the publisher can push replacement runtime code that then executes on installer machines. The entire main bundle is transformed with obfuscator.io (rotated string-array decoder of length 106089, hex-mangled _0xNNNN identifiers, 190k+ decoder inlinings, 155k+ string inlinings, 55k+ control-flow-flattening rewrites), so the WebSocket/update endpoints and command dispatch are runtime-reconstructed and not readable in source. Installing and running this agent grants the publisher live remote code-push and PTY-level command execution on the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
